subject: Request to open headcount: Senior Inference PM (EMEA) — interview gate & panel confirmation
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, Sarah Barnes <sarah@hirebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Request to open headcount: Senior Inference PM (EMEA) — interview gate & panel confirmation

Hi team,

I want to request approval to open a new headcount for a Senior Inference Program Manager based in EMEA (remote / hybrid London preferred). This is to support Dedicated capacity onboarding and customer-facing SLO work for our EU customers — hiring is time‑sensitive as we want ramp before Q3 renewals.

Key details:
- Role: Senior Inference PM (IC4) — product + infra-facing PM for inference runtime and customer rollouts
- Req ID (provisional): GH-1284
- Target region: EMEA
- Proposed band: $160k–$190k equivalent (localized comp will be coordinated with comp team)
- Timeline: post-requisition launch, first onsite/loop by end of Feb, offer by mid-March

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_PM_EMEA.pdf (job brief) and proposed_panel_cal.csv (preferred interview windows and suggested panelers).

Interview gate ask: I need approval to open the req and permission to schedule a 4‑panel loop (Hiring manager, Engineering lead, Product/Platform PM, and Customer Reliability/Support). Suggested panelers are in the CSV — quick ask: Laura, Marissa — can you confirm the panel composition and whether we should add an EM interview?

Candidate pipeline: Sarah from Hirebridge has an active candidate (Alex Jensen) who has already completed an initial screen and is interested in EMEA relocation. Sarah — can you share Alex's availability and confirm whether he requires a sponsor timeline?

Please respond with: APPROVE / APPROVE w/ COMP TWEAK / NEEDS MORE INFO. If approved, Tessa can spin up the req in Greenhouse and we’ll start scheduling.

Thanks,

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_PM_EMEA.pdf, proposed_panel_cal.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, Sarah Barnes <sarah@hirebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:16:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request to open headcount: Senior Inference PM (EMEA) — interview gate & panel confirmation

Olga — thanks for the write up. APPROVE with one request: please add a timeboxed EM panel (30 minutes) focused on leadership and cross-org coordination. Our infra teams will need to assess long-term ownership expectations.

Two small asks before we go live:
1) Adjust proposed band to indicate a fixed UK band and EU-localized equivalent (we can have Comp sign off but prefer the wording in the JD).
2) Add one question block in the loop that evaluates customer escalations/incident response experience.

Once updated, I’m good for the req to be created and to join the interview panel.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product — Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

APPROVE. Adding EM panel is reasonable — please keep it to 30 mins and we should standardize the rubric so scoring is consistent across interviewers.

Tessa — when you create the req, please flag Comp for a quick review (cc comp@redwood.ai). Also set interview slots in the CSV to UTC windows to make scheduling with candidate easier.

Sarah — thanks for sourcing Alex. If the candidate is comfortable with those windows please go ahead and hold tentative times. We’ll confirm panelers after Comp confirms band.

Marissa

Thanks Olga / team — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Candidate status: Alex Jensen (ex-Acme AI, inference platform lead) is keen on the role and available for a loop:
- Wed Feb 9: 09:00–12:00 GMT (good)
- Thu Feb 10: 13:00–17:00 GMT (good)
Alex noted relocation is possible with 60–90 days notice; no immediate visa constraints but prefers UK if offered.

I’ve tentatively held the Feb 9 slots and uploaded Alex's CV to the Greenhouse thread (link: https://greenhouse.example.com/candidates/ajensen). I’ll share a calendar invite once you confirm the final panelers. Recommended panelers per the CSV are acceptable — I can coordinate scheduling.

Alex, quick note: the interview loop will be virtual (Zoom). Please confirm if you prefer a local phone number or calendar invites via iCal.
